newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA OTC MARKET STAYS ALMOST UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA OTC MARKET STAYS ALMOST UNCHANGED.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market ended little changed on Tuesday with an independent all-share index inching up amid bargain-hunting in cheap stocks, traders said.
"Investors were chasing cheap listings, trying to place their funds in stocks with expected growing potential," one trader said.
The VAB-RA all-share index gained 0.9 percent to 6,538.9 points. Gainers led losers by 184 to 89, while prices for 238 stocks were flat.
The heavy weights were perceived as still too expensive with investors reluctant to buy at current levels, traders said.
Oil refineries' prices slipped, while cement makers were relatively stable, they said.
Traders said they did not expect significant market moves on Wednesday.

Arpechim oil refinery closed 2,000 lei (28 cents) weaker at 40,000, while Petrobrazi, another refinery, inched down 500 lei to 42,000. Moldocim, a cement maker, ended flat at 54,000, while Romcif went up by 200 lei to 3,600.

Two independent indices, computed by securities companies and based on average prices and market capitalisation, slipped. The BIG-OTC went down 0.17 percent to 4,928.47 points and CAS-RQ fell 0.54 percent to 1,087.
Brokers also said investors were starting to show more interest in grain traders, with Comcereal Constanta gaining 900 lei to close at 7,000.
They said grain traders might stay in high demand in coming weeks due to Romania's expected bumper grain harvest.
Overall OTC turnover rose to 26.9 billion lei on Tuesday from Monday's 23.7 billion.
-- Andrei Iva, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 ($ = 7133 Romanian Lei)
